items.question: Under what condition can a mind fixed on that object remain uncut even when the body is being severed?
premises: A body may be in the process of being cut.
A mind fixed on that object differs from the body being cut.
That fixedness prevents the cutting from affecting the mind.
items.inference: When the mind is gone to that object, severance of the body does not cut the mind.
uncertainties: Extent of separation between mind and body remains implicit.
items.plain_english: Even as the body is being cut, the mind that has gone to that object and is fixed upon it is not cut, just so.
